goal_checks.notes: TestRunContext_SurvivesParentCancel, _OwnTimeout, _OwnCancel all pass — confirms the three invariants §7.5 requires.
TestHubSubscribe_ReplayAfterSeq and _RingBufferEviction confirm topic-per-RunID, seq assignment, and bounded ring-buffer replay.

TestHubPublish_SlowSubscriberDropped confirms Publish drops a full subscriber (closes its channel, removes it) rather than blocking; the test itself would hang past its 1s timeout if Publish blocked, and it completes immediately.
TestHubSubscribe_UnsubscribeStopsDelivery (incl. double-unsubscribe) and TestHubClose_ClosesAllSubscribers (incl. double-close) both pass.

All 10 hub_test.go tests pass under plain go test. The -race requirement specifically cannot be satisfied in this environment (CGO_ENABLED=0, no C compiler) — see blocked_reason on task.json's g5. Manual review in lieu of -race: every field the Hub/topic mutate (topics map, seq, buf, subs, nextSubID) is guarded by h.mu or t.mu for every access path (topicFor, Publish, Subscribe, unsubscribe closure, Close); no field is read or written outside a lock; channel sends use select/default so Publish never blocks holding t.mu; TestHub_ConcurrentPublishSubscribe exercises 8 concurrent subscribers against 50 concurrent publishes and completes cleanly under the plain (non-race) test runner, which would still likely deadlock or panic on an actual logic bug even without race instrumentation.
